name: fsharp-cloudedge
description: Cloudflare SDK bindings for F# and Fickl, generated by Xantham.

scripts.tools:check: bun scripts/tool-packages.mjs xantham && bun scripts/tool-packages.mjs hawaii && bun scripts/tool-packages.mjs fickl
scripts.test:hawaii-tooling: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s generators/hawaii/tests -p test_*.py && node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests/ManagementIntegration -p test_*.py
scripts.test:bridge: dotnet tool restore && dotnet build tests/ByteBridge/ByteBridge.fsproj --nologo && dotnet fickl tests/ByteBridge/ByteBridge.fsproj --outDir tests/ByteBridge/fable-out --noCache && node tests/ByteBridge/check.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:integration-tooling && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:hawaii-tooling && npm run build -- --resume && npm run test:bridge
